rootCause.summary: GitHub markdown table cells keep CSS padding and images stay inline with baseline alignment, which inserts ~6px seams between consecutive images even when HTML cellpadding/cellspacing are 0.

implication: No amount of zero-margin HTML alone removes seams between stacked images. Architecture fix: single visual canvas (one GIF) for Hero+About+Stack; keep real links outside the canvas.
cssInlineNotViable: GitHub sanitizes/strips author CSS; table cellpadding attributes do not override .markdown-body td padding.
